invariants: All 54 ids are present exactly once in namespaces LQ-P01..P18, LQ-T01..T24, and LQ-X01..X12.
Every assignment owns exactly one fleet slot in 07..60; no slot or id is duplicated.
Each wave contains exactly 18 assignments: 6 Paper, 8 Task, and 4 cross-surface.
Each assignment owns one primary measurement axis. Fixture/manifest reuse is an input dependency, not permission to repeat another metric.
Intentional same-object and same-metric overlap requires reciprocal paired_assignment_ids plus a stated replication/disagreement purpose before launch.

Paper work accounts for exactly 203 frozen ids or a named frozen cohort; Task work accounts for exactly 1,527 frozen ids or a deterministic class/cohort; cross-surface work accounts for every declared fixture-by-surface cell.
Every result separates observed_facts, inferences, recommendations, and unresolved_unknowns; inferred ratings never overwrite source truth.
Every assignment is read-only and emits commands/probes, baseline/input hashes, expected and actual accounting, evidence paths, validation, risks, and a stop condition.
No assignment mutates Barkpark content, product files, dependencies, production state, or frozen evidence.
A wave stops before integration on unreconciled counts, unexplained manifest drift, attempted mutation, missing evidence, or unapproved overlap.

assignments.stop_condition: Stop after every named Paper has a reproducible oracle or a documented contradiction and recommended next experiment.

assignments.title: Evidence preservation and final Paper accounting audit
assignments.scope: Independently validate roster outputs, hashes, schema, no-mutation evidence, and exact reconciliation against the frozen baseline; do not redo content judgments.
inputs: git status and production mutation-event reads
commands_or_probes: jq -e schema checks over every JSON/JSONL deliverable
sha256sum all manifests, raw-capture bundles, normalized signatures, and reports into a checksum manifest
recompute shard unions/intersections and cohort equations
verify git diff --exit-code for product/source paths and review read-only request logs for absence of POST/PATCH/PUT/DELETE
assignments.deliverable: Signed-off evidence index with checksums, exact equations, missing/duplicate ID report, mutation audit, PASS/FAIL per assignment, and bounded follow-up list.
validation: zero product/source changes and zero content mutations
risks: missing raw captures
hashes generated after normalization instead of before
partial surface evidence mislabeled pass
assignments.stop_condition: Stop only when every equation closes and every assignment is PASS or explicitly FAIL/PARTIAL with exact missing evidence; never repair content in this lane.

assignments.title: P2 repair cohort 17-32 — criteria and evidence repairability
assignments.scope: Remaining 16 P2 Tasks; audit whether criteria/evidence gaps can be recovered from durable results, code refs, or linked Papers.
probes: trace durable evidence links
separate reconstructable facts from new authoring
define no-fabrication guardrails
assignments.validation: 16 unique ids; LS-TASK-16 union LS-TASK-17 equals all 32 P2 ids with overlap=0.
risks: post-hoc criteria can falsely rewrite history
assignments.stop_condition: Stop if repair would assert evidence not already durable.

assignments.title: Retire cohort — six-item reference and preservation audit
assignments.scope: All six accepted retire candidates; independently test reference reachability, audit value, and reversibility. Intentional paired overlap with LS-TASK-13 is allowed only for probe ids also in retire.
probes: trace parents, dependencies, Papers, and code refs
record preservation/export needs
recommend retain, quarantine, or retire with confidence
assignments.validation: Six unique ids; overlap with primary class assignments explicitly reported; no deletion or mutation.
risks: reference search can miss external consumers
assignments.stop_condition: Stop and require human review on any unresolved consumer or audit obligation.

assignments.title: Human-review cohort 001-138 — class disagreement calibration
assignments.scope: First 138 of 414 human-review Tasks; independently rate class and quality using frozen rubric, emphasizing multi-signal disagreement.
probes: record primary and alternate class with evidence
rate hard gates separately from weighted score
flag rubric ambiguity
assignments.validation: 138 unique ids, dual-class verdict where applicable, exact disagreement matrix.
risks: single-rater judgment is calibration input, not final truth
assignments.stop_condition: Stop rather than force a class when evidence supports a tie.

assignments.title: Human-review cohort 139-276 — lifecycle-sensitive semantics
assignments.scope: Middle 138 human-review Tasks; calibrate class-aware quality against lifecycle, distinguishing active intent from historical record.
probes: apply lifecycle-specific hard gates
identify cases where Cn/7 penalizes valid history or rewards hollow active work
record adjudication evidence
assignments.validation: 138 unique ids and lifecycle-by-rating disagreement table.
risks: uniform rubrics can misgrade historical or decision Tasks
assignments.stop_condition: Stop if rubric application requires changing the accepted class rules mid-shard.

assignments.title: Human-review cohort 277-414 — evidence provenance and final calibration set
assignments.scope: Final 138 human-review Tasks; audit evidence provenance and nominate a balanced calibration fixture set for Verify/Experiment.
probes: trace result/code/Paper evidence
select fixtures across classes, lifecycles, and disagreement modes
record why each fixture is representative
assignments.validation: 138 unique ids; LS-TASK-19..21 union equals all 414 human-review ids with pairwise overlap=0.
risks: fixture cherry-picking can bias later experiments
assignments.stop_condition: Stop if the proposed fixture set lacks every accepted class and material lifecycle.

assignments.title: Active placement and label gaps — exact paired-cohort audit
assignments.scope: Audit the accepted active-placement gap cohort (84) and active-label gap cohort (224). Their intersection is permitted and must be measured, not deduplicated silently.
probes: derive intended project/phase only from durable parents/Papers
test label vocabulary consistency
separate missing metadata from incorrect metadata
assignments.validation: Placement subtotal=84; labels subtotal=224; intersection and union computed exactly; every id tied to its selector(s).
risks: live active membership can drift
metadata inference can encode wrong priority
assignments.stop_condition: Stop if either accepted subtotal cannot be reproduced from the frozen manifest.

assignments.title: Semantic criteria and evidence-truth control sample
assignments.scope: Audit all 59 accepted active Tasks missing criteria plus an exact 60-Task control: the first 60 stable ids among active Tasks with criteria present. Compare absence against semantic weakness and evidence provenance.
probes: rate whether present criteria are testable and outcome-linked
trace proof/evidence sources
compare Cn mechanical presence with semantic quality
assignments.validation: 59 missing + 60 controls =119 unique ids; no cross-group overlap; matched class/lifecycle distribution reported as limitation if imbalanced.
risks: ordinal control may not be statistically representative
criteria presence does not prove truth
assignments.stop_condition: Stop if fewer than 60 frozen active criteria-present Tasks exist or if evidence would require mutation.

assignments.title: All 82 ambiguous multi-signal Tasks — Cn disagreement adjudication
assignments.scope: Exhaustively double-rate the accepted 82 ambiguous multi-signal Tasks against class-aware quality and fixed Cn/7; produce calibration inputs, not final product truth.
probes: compute Cn/7 mechanically
independently score class-aware rubric and hard gates
record direction/magnitude/cause of disagreement and evidence confidence
assignments.validation: 82 unique ids; two scores plus hard-gate verdict per id; exact disagreement distribution and unresolved ties.
risks: class-aware ratings remain inference until independent Verify adjudication
assignments.stop_condition: Stop on cohort hash mismatch or when a score lacks a cited durable fact.

assignments.title: Three-cycle read/render idempotence proof
assignments.scope: Run the twelve LQ-X01 fixtures through three read-render-normalize cycles in non-mutating CLI/TUI and public/email harnesses; reuse is explicitly paired, metric is idempotence only.
commands_or_probes: Run three isolated cycles without Barkpark saves
hash normalized semantic output across cycles
assignments.deliverable: A 72-output hash ledger and minimal diffs for non-idempotence.
validation: every hash change explained or failed
risks: over-normalization masks drift
timestamps create nondeterminism
assignments.stop_condition: Stop if a harness attempts persistence or normalization removes semantics; preserve raw output.

assignments.title: Cross-surface hostile-content safety survey
assignments.scope: Observe ten inert hostile fixtures (script markup, event attributes, javascript/data URLs, malformed nesting, oversized text, bidi controls, tracking pixel, external media, formula-like text, terminal escapes) across all five surfaces.
commands_or_probes: Render without following links or loading external resources
record escaping, sanitization, terminal control handling, remote requests, and crashes
assignments.deliverable: A 50-cell safety matrix with execution/network assertions.
risks: fixtures can escape weak isolation
static output differs from client behavior
assignments.stop_condition: Immediately stop an affected probe on execution, request, credential prompt, or write; quarantine evidence.

assignments.title: Frozen-baseline drift and membership reconciliation
assignments.scope: Compare frozen Wave-02 Paper and Task hashes/counts against one current read-only snapshot, attributing additions/removals/mutations without redoing classification.
commands_or_probes: Fetch one bounded raw snapshot via accepted retrieval path
hash sorted id manifests
emit added, removed, changed, unchanged sets
assignments.deliverable: A signed drift ledger preserving frozen results and exact later-survey delta.
risks: pagination_stalled can create false removals
concurrent writes can break atomicity
assignments.stop_condition: Stop on pagination stall, inconsistent bounds, or failed equations; never infer deletion from one bad read.

assignments.title: Fifty-four-assignment integration evidence audit
assignments.scope: Validate all Paper, Task, and cross-surface survey results against the global roster contract without repairing source artifacts.
commands_or_probes: Schema-validate every result
reconcile ids, slots, counts, expected/actual accounting, evidence readability, stop outcomes, and factual conflicts
assignments.deliverable: A machine-readable integration ledger, missing-evidence list, contradiction register, and go/no-go verdict.
risks: schema completeness is not evidence quality
late drift can invalidate results
assignments.stop_condition: Return no-go for any missing, duplicate, unvalidated, mutating, fact/inference-mixed, or count-inconsistent result.

stop_condition: Do not launch the fleet unless every validation check is PASS, the baseline/source hashes match, and all 54 assignments remain read-only.
